# Empty statements between or after evaluated statements do not change the integer result.
1;;2 => 2
let x = 2;; x => 2
if 1 { ; 4 } else { 0 } => 4
if 0 { 1 } else { ; 8; } => 8
fn f() { ; 3 }; f() => 3
let x = 0; while x < 2 { ; x = x + 1;; }; x => 2
match 1 { 1 => { ; 4 }, _ => 0 } => 4
let xs = [2];;; xs[0] => 2
1; ; => 1
1;;; => 1
;; => expected integer
{ ; } => expected integer
1 2 => expected semicolon
1; @ => expected integer
1 @ => trailing input
